chk.text: Hidetsugu kills Boss Uramon's task force except for Toshiro Umezawa, with whom he agrees to form the Hyozan Reckoners, and he finds a worthy apprentice in Kobo.
He sends Kobo with Toshi to Jukai, where Kobo is killed by Choryu, and Hidetsugu tortures Choryu for months and vows total revenge.
He then assaults Minamo, defeats Keiga, destroys the Academy and summons the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos, whose army he unleashes on Otawara, and Toshi declares war on him.

Marrow-Gnawer stabs one of Hidetsugu's eyes and Toshi stabs the other, and when O-Kagachi tears the oni in two, Hidetsugu returns with restored eyes, merged with the All-Consuming, and consumes Mochi.

bok.text: In Betrayers of Kamigawa, Hidetsugu holds over a dozen oni in blood oath, and he plans to raze Minamo and Otawara until Toshi persuades him to attack Jukai first.
He gives the Yuki-Onna plate to Godo, who cracks it at the border with Towabara, and his forces attack Minamo and kill Keiga.

sok.text: In Saviors of Kamigawa, Toshi finds the oni eating Minamo's library and meets Hidetsugu, who wants his full commitment to the Hyozan Reckoners, and when Toshi refuses they become enemies.
Hidetsugu reveals that the oath kills any who kill without drawing blood and chokes Kiku and Toshi, but Marrow-Gnawer stabs him in the eyes, bringing the oath's wrath on himself.

When O-Kagachi appears and the Oni of Chaos flees, Hidetsugu's spirit breaks, and Hidetsugu devours the failed oni, becoming the most formidable demonic entity until Kyodai imprisons him in the spirit realm.

fdn.text: In Foundations, Hidetsugu is the once-mortal ogre who devoured his demonic patron and transcended mortality in a fit of rage.
